Three.js 0.180.0 (MIT)
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.180.0.tgz
Package SHA256: ad66d724565ee29a2467277fa84daa5ed0211d6b8d446e9ef29f6bae0cd14144

Official minified WebGL/core builds and the required example addons.
Addon bare imports of three are rewritten to the local module using relative paths.
Reflector.js additionally generalizes its oblique clipping to the studio's continuous
perspective-to-orthographic camera projection (marked VHS in source).
Other source remains upstream; no CDN, npm install, or frontend build is needed at runtime.
See THREE-LICENSE.txt.
